hypothesis: Explicitly separating long-prompt processing may allow per-request option cardinality to explain the remaining variation more effectively than it did alongside a continuous character-count feature.

pcvs.name: default_tokenization
pcvs.rationale: Separates initialization work in the initial default-options call.

pcvs.name: tokenization_option_work
pcvs.rationale: Tracks option processing repeated for each request.

pcvs.expression: 0 if prompts.gi_frame.f_locals.get('tokenization_kwargs') is None else sum((1 for p in prompts.gi_frame.f_locals['.0'].gi_frame.f_locals['self'].iterable if len(p['prompt'] if 'prompt' in p else p) >= 128))
pcvs.name: long_prompt_requests
pcvs.rationale: Separates the additional tokenization and input-processing work of long prompts using inexpensive length checks.
